Pin Module Traces

Source: R/orchestration.R
pin_trace.Rd

Save module execution traces to a pins board. Traces include timing, token usage, and optionally the full prompts and outputs.

Usage

pin_trace(
  board,
  name,
  module,
  include_prompts = FALSE,
  include_outputs = FALSE,
  description = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

board

A pins board object

name

Character name for the pin

module

A DSPrrr module with recorded traces

include_prompts

Logical; include full prompts (default FALSE)

include_outputs

Logical; include full outputs (default FALSE)

description

Optional description for the pin

...

Additional arguments passed to pins::pin_write()

Value

The pin name (invisibly)

See also

Other orchestration: orchestration, pin_module_config(), pin_vitals_log(), restore_module_config(), use_dsprrr_template(), validate_workflow()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
board <- pins::board_folder("pins")

# Run some predictions to generate traces
results <- run(mod, text = test_texts, .llm = llm)

# Save traces for later analysis
pin_trace(board, "experiment-2024-01-traces", mod,
          include_prompts = TRUE,
          description = "Production run traces")
} # }
